svg.text: ROUND 331 · PARALLEL SAMPLING (n=16 / GRPO G=16) SHARED PROMPT KV & TAIL-BLOCK COPY-ON-WRITE
Why Unaligned 4,005-Token Prompts Corrupt 93.75% of Shared Rollouts & How Tail CoW Fixes It
Provenance: synthetic + anonymized_reported (independently_reproduced=false, physical_gpu_cluster_measurement=not_measured)
⛔ Trap 1 & 2: 16x Prefill Bloat or 93.75% Tail Race
1. Naive n=16 Expansion (31.36 GB KV & 1,480 ms TTFT)
• Expands `n=16` into 16 separate 4,005-token requests before prefill
• Computes 64,080 prefill tokens -> 1,480 ms TTFT & 31.36 GB HBM!
Wastes 93.75% of prefill FLOPs and HBM capacity during GRPO rollout!
2. Partial Tail-Block Race (`4005 % 16 = 5` -> 15/16 Corrupted!)
• Block #250 holds 5 prompt tokens (slots 0..4) shared across 16 children
• On Decode Step 1, all 16 children write token #4005 to `(block 250, slot 5)`!
15 out of 16 rollouts have their generated KV silently overwritten (93.75% bug)!
Net Impact of Naive Parallel Sampling / GRPO Rollout:
Either 15.8x HBM Waste (31.36 GB) OR 93.75% Silent KV Race Corruption
Occurs whenever `prompt_len % block_size != 0` (`4,005 % 16 = 5`)
🏆 Tier 4: Shared Full Blocks + Tail-Block Copy-on-Write
1. Zero-Copy `ref_count = 16` on 250 Full Blocks (4,000 Tokens)
• Run 1 prefill (`95.0 ms`); blocks `0..249` are 100% full & immutable
• All 16 children map blocks `0..249` to the exact same physical IDs!
Zero D2D copy for 99.88% of prompt KV states!
2. Copy-on-Write (CoW) Fork on Only Partial Tail Block #250
• Detects `ref_count == 16 > 1` when appending slot 5 of tail block #250
• Allocates 15 private tail blocks & copies ONLY the 5 prefix slots (0.05 ms)!
Each child writes its generated slots `5..15` into its own isolated tail block!
Production Verification Summary (L=4,005, n=16 Rollouts):
95.05 ms TTFT (15.6x Faster) · 1.98 GB Prompt KV (15.8x Lower HBM)
0.0% Tail-Block Write Race Corruption · 0.05 ms CoW Fork Cost
Key Takeaway: Share full prefix blocks (`ref_count=n`), but always trigger Copy-on-Write before appending to a shared partial tail block.
